facts.text: Audrey takes responsibility seriously for ensuring the well-being of her dogs.

evidence.quote: Taking care of them is a big deal. It makes me really happy and I take that responsibility seriously.
I love them so much and I want to make them as happy as possible.

facts.text: Audrey finds the care of her dogs to be rewarding despite the challenges.

evidence.quote: It can be tough but it's super rewarding.

facts.text: Audrey maintains her dogs' health and happiness through regular grooming and care.

evidence.quote: Regular grooming is essential to keep them looking good. Daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims, and lots of love is what helps them stay healthy and happy.
